card: Adds a test verifying that peers connecting with exactly MIN_PEER_PROTO_VERSION are not disconnected during the initial version handshake. Existing tests fail to catch an off-by-one regression where peers on the minimum supported protocol version are dropped. The change was identified via automated mutation testing of net_processing.cpp.
evidence: PR description points to a surviving mutant in net_processing.cpp: 'if (nVersion <= MIN_PEER_PROTO_VERSION)' where the mutant replaces strict inequality with less-than-or-equal
problem: Existing test coverage does not verify that peers running the exact MIN_PEER_PROTO_VERSION remain connected, allowing an off-by-one mutant (comparing '<=' instead of '<') to survive unnoticed in mutation testing.

risk.why: Only touches test code and cannot impact node operation or consensus.

scope_notes: Small test-only addition (+28 lines in 1 test file).
summary: Adds a test verifying that peers advertising exactly MIN_PEER_PROTO_VERSION are not disconnected during the version handshake. It ensures the minimum supported protocol version threshold is checked strictly without an off-by-one error.
